meta.name: visual-qa
meta.description: Runs rigorous visual QA across web, terminal, and paginated surfaces with screenshot evidence and a verdict. Use for any UI build or change, or when asked whether a page, component, or TUI looks right.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 给网页和终端界面做视觉体检,附截图证据和明确结论
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果刚改完页面或组件,想确认视觉上没跑偏。
copy.tagline_en: Visually check web and terminal UIs with screenshots and a clear verdict
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you just changed a page or component and need to confirm it still looks right

howto.what: 做完或改动界面后，它会截图（或抓取终端画面）跑脚本比对参考图，再派两个只读审查子代理检查，最后按每个页面给出 PASS / REVISE / FAIL 结论。
howto.when: 在你构建或改动任何界面之后触发；被问到页面、组件、终端 TUI 等看起来对不对时也会接管。没有渲染界面的纯后端逻辑不适用。

say.text: 帮我给这个页面做一次视觉 QA
say.note: 它截图比对后给出结论

say.text: 这个终端 TUI 的边框和宽度溢出有问题吗
say.note: 跑 TUI 宽度检查并报告

say.text: 把这张参考图和当前页面截图做像素比对
say.note: 输出差异比例与热点区域

howto.what_en: After you build or change a UI, it captures screenshots or terminal captures, runs a script diff against the reference, dispatches two read-only reviewer subagents, and returns a per-page PASS/REVISE/FAIL verdict.
howto.when_en: Triggers after you build or change any UI, or when asked whether a page, component, or TUI looks right. Covers web pages, terminal TUIs, and paginated documents.

say_en.text: Run visual QA on this page
Does this TUI have border or overflow issues?
Pixel-diff this reference against the current screenshot
